text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: The race is starting soon, though...

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, are you feeling nervous?
Fidgety, or having trouble breathing...?

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Please don't hesitate to speak your mind.
If you're feeling anxious, I can...
choice_data_list: I feel like you're the one who's more restless.
I feel like you're the one who's fidgeting more.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: Well, now that you mention it... Hehe.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: I just couldn't help it—I wanted everyone to know as soon as possible how amazing Trainer is.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: In this race... I'll go prove it to everyone♪
